## How to Add a New Assignment

1. Create `assignments/homework-NN.qmd` using `assignments/homework-01.qmd` as a template.
2. Add a link on this page.
3. Add the file to the sidebar in `_quarto.yml` under the "Assignments" section.
4. Update the [schedule](schedule.qmd) with the due date.
5. Run `quarto render` to rebuild the site.
